RESEARCH DESK

What we know, and where it comes from.

Herbert’s ecology, real granular physics and the artistic model are different kinds of knowledge. This guide identifies their sources.

Original fiction

Fictional facts described in the original novels. These are not biological measurements.

Physics analogy

Research on granular materials and real small animals. Extrapolation to a giant worm has not been validated.

Schematic

Conceptual organs, paths and gestures created to explain ideas; these are not a canonical dissection.
